items.title: Edward "Noon" Johnson Interview, 1960-05-28
items.q: a fellow called Freddie Gould, I believe he was living somewhere in Alton town. He was a wonderful old time guitar picker.

ctx.x: Oh yeah I heard it again, I never got there.

And violin, guitar, a fellow called Freddie Gould, I believe he was living somewhere in Alton town. He was a wonderful old time guitar picker. And Freddie Gould and slow drag, Lucian on violin. Willis St. Diego played the violin. And Freddie Gould played the guitar. Well one other question too about nowadays of course the little kids, you didn't take up music until you were about fourteen you say.
